title: Marketing & Brand Associate
desc: We're looking for a Marketing & Brand Associate to own our content, social media presence and pitch materials. You'll manage Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn pages, design brand creatives, build investor-ready pitch decks, and research potential investors and accelerators. Ideal for a final-year student or recent graduate who wants real startup experience with actual stakes.
responsibilities: Manage the company's Facebook, Instagram and LinkedIn pages
Plan, create and publish engaging social media content
Design posters, banners, flyers and social media creatives maintaining a consistent brand identity
Build investor-ready presentations and pitch decks
Research and shortlist potential angel investors, VCs and accelerators
Help draft outreach/introduction messages to investors and partners
Work closely with the founding team to represent our products convincingly
requirements: Creativity with an eye for design and branding
Strong design skills (Canva, Figma, Adobe Suite or similar)
Comfortable building presentations in PowerPoint / Google Slides / Canva
Good written English with an instinct for persuasive content
Ability to manage multiple tasks and meet deadlines
Genuine interest in startups, marketing or branding
niceToHave: Experience running a social media page (personal, university club, or otherwise)
Any prior exposure to pitch decks, fundraising, investor outreach or startup culture
